title: Submanifolds of higher rank with curvature normals of constant length
summary: We study the local geometry of Euclidean submanifolds of rank at least two whose curvature normals with respect to the flat part of the normal bundle have constant length, equivalently, whose adapted third fundamental form has constant eigenvalues. The complete case was fully settled by Di Scala and the third author, who showed that such a complete submanifold has constant principal curvatures.
